items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] In the old days, you'd have Peter Bogaj. Peter Bogaj.

ctx.x: Yeah. Complete change, man. Complete change in the band.
In the old days, you'd have Peter Bogaj. Peter Bogaj.
Tio. Tio. Charlie Bogaj playing banjo. Albert Oney Grand Alto, saxophone.
